title: Second-brain note-taking app
summary: A note app that connects your ideas and resurfaces them when useful.
whyTempting: Knowledge workers drown in notes; enthusiasts evangelise loudly.
whyItFails: Crowded and free. Notion, Obsidian, Apple Notes and Google Keep cover most needs. Switching cost. People don't migrate years of notes. Power-user trap. Enthusiasts love it, mainstream users find it too much work.
whatWouldChange: Capture becomes zero effort (voice, screen, meetings) and retrieval is conversational.

attempts.notes: Free plan cut back sharply in 2023 and 2024.

reasons.detail: Crowded and free: Notion, Obsidian, Apple Notes and Google Keep cover most needs.
